$ rea inspect-byte-entropy --help
exit: 0
--- stdout
rea inspect-byte-entropy — Inspect file-wide and block byte entropy without executing the file

Usage: rea inspect-byte-entropy <path> [options]

Arguments:
  path  Local file

Options:
  --block-size <value>  Power-of-two block size from 256 to 65536 bytes (default: 4096)
  --offset <value>      Window start as a decimal file byte offset (default: 0)
  --length <value>      Window length in bytes; omit to extend through EOF

Custom Global Options:
  --timings  Write measured command timing to stderr.

Global Options:
  --filter-output <keys>                      Filter output by key paths (e.g. foo,bar.baz,a[0,3])
  --format <toon|json|yaml|md|jsonl|csv|tsv>  Output format
  --full-output                               Show full output envelope
  --help                                      Show help
  --llms, --llms-full                         Print LLM-readable manifest
  --schema                                    Show JSON Schema for command
  --token-count                               Print token count of output (instead of output)
  --token-limit <n>                           Limit output to n tokens
  --token-offset <n>                          Skip first n tokens of output
<end>
--- stderr
<end>
